授業概要
この講義は英語で行われます。
During the course, we discuss about the fundamental theory of laser diode, which is one of the representative of opto-electronic devices. We especially treat "rate-equation" as basis, and we exploit it to static and dynamic analysis of the device.
This lecture is carried only in English.

授業計画
1) Fundamental theory of quantum dynamics
2) Fundamental theory of emission
3) Rate equation
4) Static theory
5) Dynamic theory (small signal frequency response)
